name: publicWeb_getChatMessages
description: One chat thread's messages for a web member (E9.F7.S15) through the app's own SPs, chosen by @kind: 'run' → HC6.hcapp_getEventMessages, 'kennel' → HC6.hcapp_getKennelMessages, 'dm' → HC6.hcapp_getDirectMessages (@apiOnlyRowsets = 0, so no read-receipt device rowset), 'room' → HC6.hcapp_getRoomMessages. The wrapper only resolves public ids (PublicEventId → Event.id, PublicKennelId → Kennel.id) and the caller's PublicHasherId (Me), emits its own envelope, then EXECs the app SP, whose rowsets follow unchanged. Auth: the wrapped SP's HC6.ValidateAppAuth — the token must be signed for the SP that @kind selects. @markRead applies to 'dm' and 'room' only; the run and kennel SPs take no such parameter (the kennel SP's full fetch turns a never-chosen kennel bell on). Since 2026-10-13 the token is checked (HC6.ValidateAppAuth as the inner SP for @kind) BEFORE the success row; a refusal returns success 0 + error detail.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id (the web member session). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for the app SP that @kind selects (hcapp_getEventMessages / hcapp_getKennelMessages / hcapp_getDirectMessages / hcapp_getRoomMessages) (the SP that validates it). No SQL default.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: kind = 'dm': the thread id from the chat list (E9.F1.S7).

parameters.name: sinceSequenceCount
parameters.description: Delta fetch: only messages newer than this. NULL = full fetch.

parameters.name: reactionsSince
parameters.description: Watermark from the last ReactionsAsOf row; NULL = no reaction updates.

parameters.name: markRead
parameters.description: 1 = mark the thread read (dm and room only). Default 0.

rowsets.name: NotFoundEnvelope
rowsets.description: When @me is NULL (unknown device), @kind is not run/kennel/room/dm, or the kind's id does not resolve (run: no live HC.Event for @publicEventId; kennel: no live HC.Kennel for @publicKennelId; room: @roomType NULL; dm: @threadId NULL): { success = 0, errorCode = 1230, errorType = 12, Me } then the detail at index 1; RETURN. Logged to HC.ErrorLog before returning.

columns.name: Me
columns.description: Caller's PublicHasherId (upper case) or NULL.

rowsets.description: After NotFoundEnvelope: errorCode 1230, errorType 12, errorTitle 'Not found', errorUserMessage 'That chat could not be found.' (no debugMessage column).

rowsets.name: WrapperEnvelope
rowsets.description: Otherwise: the wrapper's success envelope with the caller's public id, emitted BEFORE the wrapped SP runs.

columns.name: success
columns.description: Always 1 here.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Always NULL.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Always NULL.

columns.name: Me
columns.description: UPPER(CAST(Hasher.PublicHasherId AS NVARCHAR(40))) of the device's hasher, so the web can mark its own messages; NULL when @deviceId matches no live device (the wrapped SP's auth then fails at index 1).

rowsets.description: When the wrapped SP fails ValidateAppAuth (token not signed for the SP that @kind selects) or rejects its id (hcapp_getDirectMessages 2015 not your thread; hcapp_getRoomMessages 1944 not permitted): its error detail alone, after the success WrapperEnvelope.

rowsets.name: Messages
rowsets.description: Messages, the same shape from all four wrapped SPs (hcapp_getEventMessages / hcapp_getKennelMessages / hcapp_getDirectMessages / hcapp_getRoomMessages): Live messages of the run thread the reader may see, ORDER BY createdAt DESC. Empty when nothing is newer than @sinceSequenceCount.

columns.name: id
columns.description: EventMessage.id uppercased via UPPER(). Returned as string, not typed UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Literal constant 'text' for all rows.

columns.name: text
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageContent. NOT NULL in base table.

columns.name: roomId
columns.description: EventMessage.PublicEventId. NOT NULL in base table.

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds computed via DATEDIFF_BIG(MILLISECOND, '1970-01-01', msg.createdAt).

columns.name: authorId
columns.description: Hasher.PublicHasherId uppercased via UPPER(). NOT NULL in base table.

columns.name: authorFirstName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName — persisted computed column, never NULL (falls back to '<no names provided>').

columns.name: authorImageUrl
columns.description: Hasher.Photo. NULL when hasher has no profile photo.

columns.name: sequenceCount
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageSequenceCount — the delta watermark.

columns.name: messageKind
columns.description: 0 text, 1 photo, 2 location

columns.name: canDelete
columns.description: 1 when the caller wrote it or may moderate this thread (HC6.nonApi_mayModerateChat)

columns.name: replyToMessageId
columns.description: EventMessage.ReplyToMessageId, UPPER-cased; NULL when not a reply (E9.F1.S21).

columns.name: replyToText
columns.description: First 200 characters of the quoted message; NULL when not a reply or the original was removed.

columns.name: replyToKind
columns.description: The quoted message's MessageKind.

columns.name: replyToAuthor
columns.description: The quoted message's author DisplayName.

columns.name: replyToRemoved
columns.description: 1 when the quoted message exists but was removed.

columns.name: reactions
columns.description: EventMessage.ReactionsJson (E9.F1.S22).

rowsets.name: Thread

columns.name: unreadCount
columns.description: Live messages by the other hasher above the caller's LastSequenceCount, 0 when blocked.

columns.name: canSend
columns.description: 1 when both rows live and nobody blocks

columns.name: muted
columns.description: 1 when the caller's FriendNotificationPreference is 3 (silver bell).

columns.name: pinned
columns.description: The caller's HasherFriendMap.Pinned for this thread (E9.F1.S25).

columns.name: otherReadSequenceCount
columns.description: How far the OTHER hasher has read (their badge row's LastSequenceCount, 0 when none): the caller's messages at or below it show as read (E9.F1.S24).

rowsets.description: kind = 'dm' only (hcapp_getDirectMessages): One row (the other hasher), computed BEFORE the mark.

rowsets.name: Badge
rowsets.description: kind = 'room' only (hcapp_getRoomMessages): One row, computed BEFORE the mark so the caller learns what it had to clear.

columns.name: unreadCount
columns.description: Live messages by others, not blocked, above the caller's LastSequenceCount for this room (0 when no badge row).

columns.name: newestSequenceCount
columns.description: MAX(MessageSequenceCount) of live messages in the room; 0 when the room is empty.

rowsets.name: RemovedMessageIds
rowsets.description: Index 2 for kind 'run' / 'kennel', index 3 for 'dm' / 'room' (after the Thread / Badge row): Every removed message in this thread (Removed = 1), so a client drops any it already drew — a delta by sequence number never sees a deletion (E9.F1.S13/S14). Find it by column name.

columns.name: removedId
columns.description: Id of a removed message (same case as the message ids)

rowsets.name: ReactionUpdates
rowsets.description: Index 3 for kind 'run' / 'kennel', index 4 for 'dm' / 'room' (after the Thread / Badge row): ALWAYS present (empty when @reactionsSince is NULL or nothing changed): { id, reactions } for live messages at or below @sinceSequenceCount whose ReactionsUpdatedAt is after @reactionsSince (E9.F1.S22).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Message id

columns.name: reactions
columns.description: ReactionsJson

rowsets.name: ReactionsAsOf
rowsets.description: Index 4 for kind 'run' / 'kennel', index 5 for 'dm' / 'room' (after the Thread / Badge row): One row { reactionsAsOf } — server time; pass back as @reactionsSince.

columns.name: reactionsAsOf
columns.description: SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

rowsets.name: UnhandledErrorTail
rowsets.description: CATCH path: appended after whatever rowsets were already sent (the success envelope at least, so its position varies — find it by success = 0 / errorCode 1500): { success = 0, errorCode = 1500, errorType = 5 }. No StandardErrorResult follows and the error is not re-raised. The wrapped SPs log and THROW, so this row follows any failure inside them.

sideEffects: EXEC the selected hcapp_ SP — every side effect is its own: hcapp_getRoomMessages / hcapp_getDirectMessages advance the caller's HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts / HasherFriendMap read position when @markRead = 1; hcapp_getKennelMessages on a full fetch turns a never-chosen KennelNotificationPreference 0 → 1 on the caller's HasherKennelMap row.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the 1230 not-found path (line 44) and in the CATCH (line 68, userId NULL).

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: Not-found log omits the dm thread id
codeSmells.detail: The 1230 ErrorLog description (lines 46-47) records kind, event, kennel and room but not @threadId, so a failed 'dm' request logs four nulls.

Lines 33-37 resolve the device's PublicHasherId and the run/kennel ids before any token check, so a caller with only a device id can tell an existing public event or kennel id (success envelope) from a missing one (1230). Low value, but it is a probe the token would otherwise stop.
Every wrapped SP logs and THROWs; the wrapper's CATCH (lines 66-71) logs a second HC.ErrorLog row.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
